old_description: This site has limited support for your browser. We recommend switching to Edge, Chrome, Safari, or Firefox.
about:
Upstate Elevator is based in Burlington, Vermont. The company does not publicly disclose its founding year, ownership structure, or the names of its founders. It began as a Vermont-focused hemp brand emphasizing organic cultivation and transparent testing.

The company manufactures a line of CBD and THC products including gummies, beverages, capsules, tinctures, topicals, and pet chews. All items are described as handcrafted in Vermont using Vermont-grown hemp and are third-party tested. The brand holds USDA Organic certification for select products and formulates with minor cannabinoids such as CBN, CBG, THCV, and CBDA alongside CBD and THC.

Upstate Elevator sells directly to consumers through its e-commerce site and also offers a wholesale program for retailers. Its customer base spans the dietary supplement, hemp-derived cannabis, and pet wellness markets. Products are marketed for sleep, calm, relief, focus, and vibe categories.

The company positions itself on "Clean Crafted" principles: USDA Organic certification, third-party lab analysis, and Vermont-sourced hemp. Its stated mission centers on providing clean, tested cannabinoid products grown and made in Vermont.

name: Uptime Power Systems Inc.
old_description: specializes in supplying emergency power systems for data centers and mission critical applications.
about:
Uptime Power Systems operates from Warren, Rhode Island, serving New England and the Mid-Atlantic as a manufacturer's representative for emergency power equipment. The firm was co-founded by Michael Redman and Rich Su, both veterans of Eaton and American Power Conversion, who brought decades of critical-power experience to the venture.

The company represents a portfolio of manufacturers including Schneider Electric, Starline, SAI Advanced Power Solutions, BTECH, Trystar, PQ Protection, Bender, HITEC, PermAlert, REON, and Olsun Electrics. Its service scope spans design consultation, equipment selection, layout, project management, load-bank testing, infrared scanning, and commissioning support for UPS systems, switchgear, power distribution units, busway, cooling, battery monitoring, and prefabricated data-center modules. A seven-person team — including a licensed professional engineer and former Eaton application engineers — delivers technical support from specification through startup.

Uptime's customers operate in data centers, healthcare and medical imaging, industrial plants, utilities, institutional and public facilities, transit systems, water and wastewater treatment, and life-sciences laboratories. The firm works directly with consulting engineers, contractors, and facilities teams that require reliable backup power in environments where downtime carries significant risk.

Uptime positions itself as a single point of accountability for the entire power chain, emphasizing that it remains engaged after the purchase order through commissioning and ongoing support. The company highlights its regional knowledge of utilities, codes, and contractors as a differentiator against national firms, combined with the technical depth of its manufacturer relationships.

name: UrbanTimberSupply
old_description: Locally salvaged hardwood • Residential and commercial builds • Established 2015
about:
Founded in 2015 in Murfreesboro, Tennessee, Urban Timber Supply began by crafting custom furniture from locally salvaged hardwood, often sourced from trees that have been part of a family's history for generations. The company transforms these logs into pieces intended to last for generations to come.

The workshop produces a range of custom wood furniture, from small handcrafted items such as executive pens to 15-foot conference tables. Using live-edge slabs of walnut, maple, ash, poplar, cherry, and oak, the team mills, finishes, and occasionally incorporates epoxy resin to accentuate the natural character of each piece. An inventory of hand-selected slabs — black walnut up to 15 feet long and maple up to 15 feet long — is kept on hand for immediate projects.

Urban Timber Supply serves both residential and commercial clients. Homeowners commission dining tables, benches, and statement pieces like a black walnut pool table built into a beachfront home. Commercial projects include office builds and conference tables, notably a custom table installed in the historic Murfreesboro Courthouse.

The company emphasizes preserving the story embedded in the wood. Its approach centers on well-sourced material, careful craftsmanship, and designs meant to feel personal, substantial, and lasting — turning a client's own tree into a functional heirloom.

about:
URtech Manufacturing, based in Fort Lauderdale, Florida, was founded in 2010. The company was established by professionals with decades of EMS and OEM manufacturing experience, aiming to apply large-company principles within a smaller, user-friendly footprint.

The firm provides end-to-end electronic manufacturing services (EMS) to original equipment manufacturers. Its capabilities span supply chain management, component sourcing through a custom Asia supply network, and production across a North American footprint that includes facilities in Canada, the United States, and Mexico (as of 2021). The company emphasizes reducing global supply-chain risks for its clients.

URtech serves OEMs across various sectors, welcoming startups alongside established enterprises. Its service model is designed to accommodate a range of production volumes, though specific volume ranges, headcount, and facility sizes are not publicly disclosed.

The company differentiates itself by combining a broad Americas manufacturing footprint with an Asia-based component network, offering what it describes as an "unparalleled ecosystem" to competitively bring products to market while mitigating global supply-chain challenges.

name: Usherwood Office Technology
old_description: Usherwood's Burlington location has provided Vermont with quality service and solutions for all of their IT business needs since 2016. Our vehicles travel throughout the Windham, Essex and Franklin counties as they meet our clients where they work to attend to any issues that may arise with their equipment.
about:
Usherwood Office Technology has served the Burlington, Vermont region from its Williston office since 2016. The location operates as part of a broader network with additional offices in West Lebanon, New Hampshire; Plattsburgh, New York; and Albany, New York. Ownership structure and founding leadership are not publicly disclosed.

The company delivers a suite of managed technology services including managed IT, managed print, document management, security and surveillance, video conferencing, cloud-based phone systems, mailing solutions, and digital signage. A three-tiered support model combines a Technical Assistance Center, certified engineers in a call center, and field technicians dispatched across Vermont, the North Country, and parts of New Hampshire. Technicians are factory-trained and live locally, enabling on-site repairs and installations. Services are offered on flat-fee contracts with technology roadmaps to help clients budget for upgrades.

Usherwood works with businesses throughout Windham, Essex, and Franklin counties in Vermont, as well as organizations in northern New Hampshire and the Adirondack and Capital regions of New York. Customer references include educational institutions and law firms, though the company addresses general business IT needs across sectors.

The firm emphasizes business continuity, local presence, and customized solutions designed from consultation through deployment and ongoing management. Its differentiators include the three-tiered service structure, predictable flat-fee pricing, and technicians embedded in the communities they serve.

name: Utah Communications, Inc.
old_description: Stay connected when seconds count, using technologies designed to keep you in touch. Motorola's two-way radios and accessories reliably connect command centers, employees in the office or off-site. Explore the full suite of powerful radios, pagers and accessories.
about:
Utah Communications, Inc. was established in 1954 in Salt Lake City, Utah, as the first and largest Motorola service shop and full Motorola dealer in the state. The company has built its business around Motorola's two-way radio ecosystem, providing sales, service, and system integration for over six decades.

The company provides turnkey public safety communications system design, including needs analysis, system design, implementation, and 24/7 maintenance. It sells and services Motorola two-way radio equipment, including MOTOTRBO digital radios with GPS positioning and text messaging, APX all-band P25 portable radios, body-worn cameras, dispatch consoles, and a full line of Motorola Original accessories. Utah Communications also offers the WAVE PTX cloud-based push-to-talk service that connects phones, computers, and radios on a single platform.

Its customers span education, fire and EMS, hospitality, law enforcement, manufacturing, and transportation sectors. Notable deployments include a MOTOTRBO and WAVE PTX system for Connexus Energy, a district-wide radio upgrade for Elmore County Public Schools, and APX radio deployment for the West Licking Joint Fire District.

Utah Communications emphasizes its six-decade partnership with Motorola Solutions and its ability to deliver a single-provider solution for all communications equipment, from system design to ongoing support.

Also we showcase a unique mattress department featuring Utah’s largest inventory of  100% natural and organic mattresses at both inexpensive and premium price points. In our opinion as well as those of several repeat customers, they sleep cooler and are better for your shoulders hips and backs, last longer, and help your health more than any other mattress on the market! about:
Utah Rustic Furniture by Bradley's operates a 10,000-square-foot showroom at 2255 S 300 W in Salt Lake City, Utah. The business traces its roots to 1953, when Ralph Bradley opened his first furniture store in downtown Salt Lake City under the Bradley-Badger Furniture name. The company remains family-owned; after several transitions, Chad and Lesa Downs became sole owners in 1997, and their son Matt has managed the operation for two decades. The store describes itself as a third-generation family enterprise.

The retailer specializes in rustic and log furniture, much of it built by hand and made custom-to-order to customer specifications. Offerings include solid-wood bedroom sets, dining tables, accent pieces, and customizable American-made leather and fabric upholstery collections. A dedicated mattress department carries what the company calls Utah's largest inventory of 100% natural and organic mattresses. The showroom also stocks lines from manufacturers such as Vaughn-Bassett, Benchcraft, Homelegance, Coaster, and Fashion Bed Group. Most furniture items are sold through the physical showroom; orders are processed via phone or email with itemized invoices.

The primary customer base is residential, including homeowners furnishing primary residences and vacation cabins in areas like Park City. The company also serves shoppers seeking natural and organic sleep products. Because the business does not operate an online checkout for furniture, sales are conducted in person or through direct contact, catering to buyers who prefer a hands-on selection process.

The company emphasizes its heritage of personal service, citing a reputation for honest guidance and a no-pressure sales approach. The founders' original focus on sleep products evolved into a full-line furniture store that highlights locally built, handmade rustic pieces alongside a curated mattress selection.

name: VR Industries, Inc
old_description: VR Industries is your Committed Partner for Electronic Manufacturing Services
about:
VR Industries, Inc. was founded in 1985 in Warwick, Rhode Island. The company has operated as an electronic contract manufacturer for nearly four decades, building a legacy of producing printed circuit board assemblies and electromechanical systems for a range of regulated industries.

The firm provides full-service manufacturing that spans printed circuit board assembly, electromechanical box-build integration, new product introduction, supply chain management, and program management. Its quality infrastructure includes automated optical inspection, high-resolution X-ray inspection, macro-zoom video inspection, and a counterfeit component verification program. All operators are certified to IPC-A-610 and J-STD-001 standards, and the facility maintains a Zero Defect program designed to reduce inspection time and cost.

VR Industries serves medical device OEMs, industrial equipment makers, U.S. military branches, green energy developers, and blue economy ventures. Medical customers include top global OEMs receiving moderate to complex PCBAs and full system assemblies. Defense work extends to every branch of the armed forces, supported by a workforce that includes veterans. Industrial clients receive custom electronic and mechanical assemblies built to ISO 9001, ISO 13485, FDA, and MIL-spec requirements.

The company emphasizes a partnership-driven model that prioritizes close collaboration from concept through delivery. Its differentiators include in-house IPC-certified trainers, a franchised-distributor supply chain strategy, and certifications covering ISO 9001, ISO 13485, ITAR, UL 508A, FDA registration, RoHS, and GIDEP.

name: VSL Packaging Company USA
old_description: Our goal at VSL Packaging is to be a one stop shop for packaging products and a leading provider of innovative retail, e-commerce, and custom corrugated packaging.
about:
VSL Packaging operates from a design office and showroom at 239 West 29th Street in Manhattan's Garment District. The company began in 2009 as the packaging arm of Varick Street Litho (VSL Print), a Manhattan commercial printer that has appeared on CNBC's The Profit. VSL Packaging launched its own dedicated website in 2020, but the operation shares the West 29th Street address and the print craft heritage of its parent company.

The company designs, prototypes, and manufactures custom packaging — rigid boxes, folding cartons, corrugated boxes, retail bags, point-of-purchase displays, corrugated shippers, and luxury mailers — all produced in New York City. The process moves through structural design, photorealistic 3D rendering, physical prototyping, dieline creation, and pre-production proofs before printing and finishing. Finishing options include embossing, debossing, foil stamping, spot UV, matte, gloss, satin, and soft-touch lamination. VSL also provides shipping and fulfillment services such as kitting, assembly, warehousing, pick-pack-ship, and freight coordination. The company reports more than 10,000 packaging projects completed across 16 box styles.

VSL serves roughly two dozen industries, including apparel, beauty, beverages, CBD, cosmetics, electronics, food, jewelry, luxury goods, medical, pharmaceuticals, and sporting goods. Its customer base ranges from early-stage startups to national brands; documented projects include packaging for Belvedere Vodka, Google, IBM, Betty Booze, Bored Cow, and Charlie Fox.

VSL differentiates itself by controlling the entire production chain under one roof: the design desk, prototyping bench, press schedule, and finishing work all reside at the same Manhattan address. The company emphasizes that it owns the job it sells, avoiding brokers and overseas factories. Quote follow-up occurs within one business day, and minimum order quantities are kept low and flexible, quoted per project.

name: VTi by M. Davis Power Distribution Equipment (owned by M. Davis & Sons, Inc.)
old_description: M. Davis & Sons manufactures and supplies low voltage industrial electrical power distribution equipment for industry partners, through the VTi by M. Davis division.
about:
VTi by M. Davis Power Distribution Equipment operates from Newark, Delaware, as a division of M. Davis & Sons, Inc. The company manufactures and supplies low-voltage industrial electrical power distribution equipment for industry partners.

The VTi division combines engineering, fabrication, and testing to produce a range of UL-listed, U.S.-made power distribution products. Its lineup includes Unitized Distribution Systems (UDS), Dual Voltage UDS (dv-UDS), Portable Power Distribution Centers (PPDC), and Fused Distribution Panels (FDP) in both AC and DC versions. The company operates a panel shop where units are assembled, tested, and shipped ready for installation, and also offers panel refurbishing services that bring outdated equipment up to current UL-certified standards.

Customers include engineering firms, industrial plants, facilities, and construction projects that need temporary or permanent power distribution. The equipment serves in-plant applications, critical process protection, and temporary power for construction sites. The dv-UDS is designed for dual-voltage requirements, while the PPDC addresses fast-turnaround portable power needs.

The company positions itself as a turnkey "One Source for All" industrial construction services provider, delivering end-to-end custom solutions from layout through field installation and startup. It highlights a 20% cost savings factor for UDS units compared to separately mounted enclosures, and emphasizes full customization, UL listing, and domestic manufacturing as key differentiators.
